summary: Stage 1 done for DirectSun. Root approved by his card of 2:27 AM PST 2026-11-28 (OWNER:1795861938602549019), with his two changes folded in as on Graffiti: 'plans around on every sunlit map' softened to 'feels wherever it shines, and on many maps plans around' (the mechanic still runs on every sunlit map), and a new sentence that shade is not always wanted: the sun's warmth is felt too (the code adds the sun to felt temperature at every temperature), so where a mountain's shadow will fall is a major concern when the player picks where to build. a_mountain_drawn answered (a): a mountain's long shadow is drawn on the ground as a soft dark band (d_mountain_drawn_band, OWNER:1795861940796843369); the greatbole trial's own ruling for trees stays open. How far a mountain's shadow may reach at a low sun is the edge for stage 2.

quick_look.scene: On ArchSmall (D:\ClaudeWork\rimmandrake\instances\b\Saves\): CROWN_SHADOW_GREATBOLE_REVIEW, 32 greatboles with drawn crown shadows at a 15-degree sun, shows how a drawn shadow band reads on the ground and how far shade spreads at a low sun, the stage-2 edge of how long a mountain's band may reach.
